description: Campgrounds at a park or across a state: amenities (potable water, showers, RV dump station, toilets, trash collection, RV access), reservable vs. first-come-first-served site counts, reservation guidance and booking URL, accessibility, and fees. Check the linked campground page for RV hookups and date-specific availability. Get park codes from nps_find_parks. Some parks list lodging or backcountry permits instead of NPS-managed campgrounds; an empty result is not an error.

parkCode.description: Park code, or comma-separated list (e.g. "zion") — 4-letter lowercase codes. Get codes from nps_find_parks. Provide parkCode or stateCode.

stateCode.description: Two-letter state code, or comma-separated list. Returns campgrounds across all NPS sites in those states.

name: nps_find_campgrounds

items.description: A single campground with amenities, site counts, and reservation info.

accessibility.description: Free-text accessibility summary, or null if NPS publishes none.

amenities.description: Key amenities: true, false, or null when NPS published no value (unknown, not absent). The campground's NPS page has the full amenity list.

dumpStation.description: RV dump station available, or null when NPS published no value.

potableWater.description: Drinking water available on site, or null when NPS published no value.

rvAllowed.description: RVs permitted, or null when NPS published no value.

showers.description: Showers available, or null when NPS published no value.

toilets.description: Toilets of any type (flush, vault, portable, composting) available, or null when NPS published no value.

trashCollection.description: Trash/recycling collection on site, or null when NPS published no value.

fee.description: Lowest campground fee as a dollar string (e.g. "30.00"), or null if free / unspecified.

firstComeSites.description: Number of first-come-first-served sites, or null.

parkCode.description: Park code the campground belongs to.

reservableSites.description: Number of reservable sites, or null. 0 means first-come-first-served only.

reservationInfo.description: Free-text reservation guidance (how/where to book), or null.

totalSites.description: Total number of campsites, or null if unspecified.

url.description: Campground's NPS.gov page with the full amenity and site detail, or null.

cap.description: Limit applied (populated when results were truncated).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_park_code`: A parkCode token isn't 4 lowercase letters. `invalid_state_code`: A stateCode token isn't two letters. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance on the result set: where else to look when no campgrounds matched, the start value for the next page when more matched, or the way back when start ran past the end.

shown.description: Campgrounds returned in this response (populated when capped by limit).

totalCount.description: Total campgrounds matching the filter before the limit was applied.

truncated.description: True when more campgrounds matched than this response returned; absent on a complete result.

title: national-parks-mcp-server: find campgrounds
